Chrysler Limo rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $150 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $350. Seats 8.

The Chrysler Limo is the classic stretch on this listing: black on the outside, colour in the cabin, and a long silhouette built for a curb arrival. It seats 8. It is a limousine, not a Sprinter and not a party bus. Prom groups, couples, anniversary hosts, and small circles of friends book it when the photograph at the door is part of the night, and when everyone in that photograph fits in one car.

What the listing already publishes is the cabin you ride in. Classic leather seats, a wet bar with custom lights, a custom sound system with subs, privacy tint, ambient lighting outside, and seventeen colour variations for the cabin lighting. The occasions named on the page are prom, Cinco de Mayo, an anniversary, a date night, a night with friends, and a concert. Those are nights for a group of 8 or fewer. This About does not publish a bag count. Tell reservations what you are bringing, and they confirm whether it fits before you pay.

Capacity, luggage, and group fit

8 seats is the right call when the whole party is in the photo: a prom group that has already agreed on one stretch, a couple who want the long black car, an anniversary pair plus the friends riding with them, or a concert group that would rather share the stretch than split into two cars. Past 8, this cabin is the wrong unit. A bachelorette that wants the pink stretch compares the Pink Hummer Limo, which seats 18. A lounge party of 13 to 16 compares the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) and the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) on the fleet.

Luggage is a separate question from seats, and this page does not answer it with a number. A night out with coats and a camera is the way a stretch is usually used. An airport arrival with checked luggage is not what this listing describes. For that ride, compare the Luxury SUV (Suburban), which seats 6 and publishes its own bag line, or ask about an Executive Sprinter. Either way, confirm the Chrysler Limo's luggage with reservations before you plan what will fit.

Best uses in Scottsdale & Phoenix

The Chrysler Limo earns its place when the group wants a real stretch limousine in Scottsdale or Phoenix, not a Sprinter dressed as one. The nights below are the ones this listing already names. Larger celebrations and bag-heavy airport runs have a better unit on the fleet.

Prom, anniversary, date night

Prom is a curb arrival: the stretch at the house or the venue, the photo, then the ride. Keep the group inside 8. The cabin lighting has seventeen colour variations, so the interior can match the night without turning the car into a bus. An anniversary uses the same idea more quietly. Dinner, a short hop between the resort and the restaurant, and the long black car in the photographs. A date night can be two people. The stretch is the point, not a full cabin. Language stays with the arrival and the ride. The listing is not a script for the evening.

Concerts & nights out

A concert or a night in town is the stretch for a small group that wants that energy without a 28-passenger Party Bus (28 Pax). You book the hours the chauffeur should stay: venue, dinner, the next stop, and back. Scottsdale nightlife transportation is the service page for that shape of evening. Name the venues when you reserve so the curb plan is real. This unit is the classic black limousine in that plan. It is not the vehicle for a party that has already outgrown 8 seats.

When not to use it

Skip the Chrysler Limo when the job is an airport run with heavy luggage. The stretch is a poor substitute for a vehicle whose listing states bag room. Use the Luxury SUV (Suburban) when the group is 6 or fewer and bags are why you are choosing, or an Executive Sprinter when the luggage or the headcount needs that cabin. Skip it too when the night is a pink bachelorette moment (the Pink Hummer Limo) or a lounge party of 13 to 16 (the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax)). The fleet index is the comparison if you are still between those units.

How booking works

Book the Chrysler Limo by the hour when the chauffeur should stay with you: prom photos plus the venue, an anniversary with more than one stop, a concert night with dinner on the way. Book a one-way transfer when the job is a single ride, hotel to a venue or airport to a resort. A ride back later is a second transfer or a round trip, priced in checkout. On the current fleet listing it is chauffeured by the hour from $150 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $350. That is the same hourly start, hourly minimum, and one-way transfer this page's About and schema Offer already publish. It is not a total.

Minimums exist. The booking card and live checkout on this page show the current minimum and the tax for the date you enter. Read pricing and the FAQ, then treat checkout as the figure for your trip. This page does not restate free-hour rules, deposits, or wait times. For the request in writing, include the date, both addresses, the passenger count, a luggage note, and either the hours or the one-way pair. Send that through contact, email reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com, or call or text (623) 986-6339. Same-day questions go to the phone so the reservations desk can confirm that date.

Chrysler Limo vs other fleet options

The choice is the headcount, the bags, and the look of the car. Seat counts here are the figures already published for those units. Still deciding? Send the headcount and the luggage note before you pay. (623) 986-6339 · reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

  • Up to 8, classic stretch look. Stay with the Chrysler Limo. Black outside, colour inside, the long silhouette at the curb. Choose it when a Sprinter would be the wrong shape and a party bus would be mostly empty.

  • Up to 6, black car, bags to carry. The Luxury SUV (Suburban) is the chauffeured SUV. Its own page publishes the bag line. Use it when luggage is the reason to leave the stretch. This Chrysler Limo page does not publish a bag count. Confirm luggage with reservations.
